papers.title: Tissue-resident CD8 + T cells link pregnancy to breast cancer protection
papers.summary: We discovered that pregnancy promotes the expansion of tissue-resident memory-like CD8+ T (TRM-like) cells in the mammary gland. This expansion is driven by mammary gland alveologenesis and cytokines produced by mammary epithelial cells. Depletion of TRM-like cells abolished pregnancy-associated protection against breast cancer, whereas expansion of these cells conferred protection
papers.llm_title_zh: 驻留于组织中的CD8+T细胞在妊娠与乳腺癌防护之间起着关键作用。
papers.llm_title_bilingual: 驻留于组织中的CD8+T细胞在妊娠与乳腺癌防护之间起着关键作用。 / Tissue-resident CD8 + T cells link pregnancy to breast cancer protection
papers.llm_research_question_zh: 我们发现，妊娠会促进乳腺中驻留记忆型CD8+ T细胞（即TRM样细胞）的数量增加。
llm_highlights_zh: 这种扩张是由乳腺小叶的形成以及乳腺上皮细胞产生的细胞因子所驱动的。
TRM样细胞的减少会消除妊娠期间对乳腺癌的防护作用，而这些细胞的增加则能提供保护效果。
驻留于组织中的CD8+T细胞在妊娠与乳腺癌防护之间起着关键作用。
